given: a stock record has previously been filed for a (sku, location) pair
then: it is read back showing the same stored SKU, location, quantity, and tracking code that were filed

independence.rationale: AC1 observes the post-save confirmation echo; this AC observes durable persistence via a later read-back, which can break (record not actually stored) while the confirmation still renders, and vice versa.

architectural_notes: E2E: asserts durable persistence by reading a previously filed record back through boundary (app/routes/) -> service -> repository -> stock_records, confirming the stored SKU/location/quantity/inventory_code match what was filed. The read path touches only the repository for ORM/session access (owner module app/repositories/); the service returns a read model the SPA renders. Cross-cutting: this AC defends the persistence contract (PI2 NOT NULL fields round-trip intact) independently of the AC1 confirmation echo; verified as a real integration test against the paired Lakebase branch with seeded rows and FK-aware cleanup.
